reference: 50 author-supplied unlabelled H&E patches from the official GigaTIME sample_test_data.zip

visual_observations.assessment: Bounded luminance adjustment makes the dense field paler while preserving H&E hues and visible nuclear structures. The tissue gap remains a tissue gap rather than a new seam. A virtual DAPI improvement is not established.

The full-LAB prototype visibly introduced cyan nuclei and was rejected. The bounded luminance-only preview preserves the original pink/purple hues but remains far from the reference chroma profile (LAB a/b mean distance 32.0). It is flagged as out of reference range and is not accepted as a corrected model input.

The source was already close to the author's stain profile; bounded lightness adjustment is mild and the gland architecture remains visible. Measured-versus-predicted marker validity is not established by this preview.

data_integrity: The optional normalized OME-TIFF exports use lossless Deflate, preserve RGB pixels and the per-source x/y microns-per-pixel metadata (0.252 for MoNuSAC; 0.325 for ORION), and round-trip exactly. They are isolated diagnostics and do not replace the frozen inputs of the live 93-image run.
next_gate: Run one separately authorized bounded CPU paired-control diagnostic with the author's measured DAPI labels and the original-versus-luminance-adjusted MoNuSAC field. Retain current QC thresholds and reject any new shadow. Do not use this preflight as evidence for classifier accuracy.
